context.label: Questions, testimony, and authority

observations.body: People ask why John’s disciples and the Pharisees’ disciples fast while Jesus’ disciples do not, and Jesus answers with bridegroom, cloth, and wineskin images.
observations.label: John’s disciples are named in a fasting question

observations.body: The passage presents Fasting, questioning, and answering as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Fasting, questioning, and answering

payload.posture: Read Mark 2:18–22 as one movement in John the Baptist's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states people ask why John’s disciples and the Pharisees’ disciples fast while Jesus’ disciples do not, and Jesus answers with bridegroom, cloth, and wineskin images. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of John the Baptist's story.
payload.title: John’s disciples are named in a fasting question
